Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: Logical comparison error. After correctly retrieving the directors’ birth years (Fernando Fernán Gómez: 1921; Charles Saunders: 1904), the Planner incorrectly concluded that 1904 is later than 1921 and thus selected the wrong film. The data gathering was correct; the mistake was in interpreting “later” and comparing the years.
